title: 2 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Peter 1: great promises, faith that grows step by step, and the sure word of prophecy.

questions.text: How does the writer name himself in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: 2 Peter 1:1 opens: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ.

answers.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle

questions.text: What has he granted, so that they may become partakers of the divine nature?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises, that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature.

answers.text: The law given to the fathers
A crown that does not fade

questions.text: In verse 5, what are they to supply in their faith?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge.

questions.text: What stands last in the list that runs from faith onward?
questions.explanation: Verses 5 to 7 end the list with godliness, then brotherly affection, and in brotherly affection, love.

questions.text: How does verse 9 describe the one who lacks these things?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

answers.text: Deaf to the word of truth
Asleep in the day of grace
Blind, seeing only what is near

questions.text: What does verse 10 promise those who do these things?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: be more diligent to make your calling and election sure, for if you do these things, you will never stumble.

questions.text: What did they not follow when they made known the power and coming of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says: we didn't follow cunningly devised fables, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

questions.text: What did the voice from the Majestic Glory say?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory: “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

questions.text: What is the sure word of prophecy compared to in verse 19?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says you do well to heed the word of prophecy, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns.

answers.text: A seed sown in good ground
A sword sharper than any other
A lamp shining in a dark place
A mirror held up to the face

questions.text: How does verse 21 say prophecy came?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says that no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: By the counsel of the elders
By the voice of an angel
By men moved by the Holy Spirit
